content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sierra Vista

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirements, then gather your project documentation. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether you qualify before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Sierra Vista-based professionals benefit from flexible scheduling that fits working schedules. You'll study the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-aligned content across five intensive days or part-time modules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI with your experience documentation and proof of course completion from Granite PM Academy. Pay the associated exam fee at the time of application. PMI will review and approve your eligibility within one to two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and one-on-one coaching to reinforce your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Most Sierra Vista professionals sit for the exam within four weeks of application approval.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During this cycle, you must earn a set number of professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or project work. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible workshops and webinars to support your ongoing certification maintenance.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
